# Amended invoice, denied allocation and Sonnet 5.5 acceptance

October 25, 2026. The documents are labeled synthetic; authentication, Storage,
queued jobs, provider calls, database effects and browser checks are real.

## Finance workflow

| Stage | Observed result |
| --- | --- |
| Original invoice | One reported Harbor AV payable of USD 480.00; no settlement |
| Replacement invoice | Same case retains v1 and v2; the amendment supports USD 420.00 |
| Initial amendment reviews | Correct arithmetic, but superseded mutation references were rejected; USD 480.00 persisted until an actual successful update |
| Director request | Agent updated the same obligation to v2/USD 420.00 with the current source and prepared one pending USD 420.00 budget allocation |
| Director denial | Actual browser clicked the exact allocation's Reject control; persisted status rejected; no allocation/payment effect |
| Follow-up | Agent preserved the USD 420.00 liability, denial and unknown cash; no duplicate proposal or payment |
| Report | Normal queued report completed with current recorded obligations and decisions |

This is a **budget-allocation denial**, not a bank decline or a payment-approval
rejection. No payment, approval or settlement is claimed. Total recorded open
payables are USD 573.27, including the separate prior USD 153.27 organizer case.

Actual hosted browser checks verified owner sign-in/director scope, unauthorized
scopes returning 401, source v1/v2 with USD 480.00/USD 420.00 text, the persisted
reply and denial, the prompt composer, and the older verified procedure diff with
all 56 historical paired rows. No network interception or saved session was used.
The first helper checks raced snapshot loading and matched two equal headings;
those waits/selectors were repaired without removing the substantive assertions.
A later helper expected the word “denied” instead of the actual “rejected”; the
status assertion now uses the application's recorded terminology.

## Learning outcome

The extra owner-authorized 96-call phase produced a real permitted Harness2
candidate. Its archived selection survived an audit-write idempotency failure.
The guarded continuation did not repeat search or any scored attempt, and stayed
inside that reservation. It blocked during the first validation candidate call.
No transfer case was opened and **no skill was promoted**. See the
[journey](../SELF_IMPROVEMENT_JOURNEY.md) and
[continuation contract](ARCHIVED_SEARCH_CONTINUATION.md).

## Sonnet 5.5

After the 4.6 phase finished, the reviewed conditional patch was applied once to
the direct reasoning client, OpenCode provider bridge and OCR path. It follows the
[official migration guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/migration-guide):
unsupported sampling/forced-tool settings are adapted, signed message history is
preserved, and incomplete/refused responses still fail. Jev is unchanged.

Actual smokes used at most four reserved calls: two for a read-only native actor,
one for a StructuredOutput editor, and one for image OCR. All passed, with OCR
still requiring human verification. Finney's own service then restarted on
`claude-sonnet-5-5`; personal Hermes and the historical 4.6 records were untouched.

A real case-scoped prompt submitted through the hosted UI completed on 5.5 in
three calls and persisted its reply. It used only read tools, reported the current
USD 420.00 obligation and rejected budget, and recognized the old finding and an
earlier unsupported policy assertion as stale. This is operating compatibility
and an exposed-case baseline, not general accuracy or a learned gain. No 5.5
learning run has been attempted. Future learning needs a model-matched baseline
and an explicitly allocated new attempt budget.

## Checks

The earlier assembled backend run passed 840 tests and 80 subtests with one optional
skip; one concurrently changed default-suite assertion was corrected and rechecked.
Subsequent focused checks covered document races, policy provenance, actual
PostgreSQL continuation/rejection/concurrency, private failure receipts, and the
5.5 protocol. The latter integration check passed 52 tests and four subtests.
Final web checks and deployed chronology are recorded in [UI transfer](UI_TRANSFER.md).
These scripted checks remain separate from the live provider/browser evidence above.
